x-changelog.summary: Action Plan Verification Method names are now immutable after creation
x-changelog.description:
The PATCH endpoint for Action Plan Verification Methods no longer accepts the `name` parameter.
Verification method names can only be set during creation (POST) and cannot be modified afterward.
This change improves API security by aligning backend parameter validation with 
frontend functionality. Other fields such as `active` remain editable.
